technology_name: Power Quality Improvement and Grid Stabilization System (STATCOM)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Voltage fluctuations, harmonic currents, and reactive power issues affecting power quality.
description: STATCOM is a static compensator designed to improve power quality by mitigating voltage fluctuations, harmonic currents, and reactive power issues. The system supports stable and efficient grid operation under varying conditions.
applications:
Electric utilities and power transmission/distribution companies
Renewable energy plants (solar, wind, and hybrid power systems)
Industrial manufacturing facilities with sensitive electrical loads
Smart grid, substation modernization, and power quality improvement projects
Engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) companies specializing in power infrastructure
